description: This class includes the manufacture of dairy products such as fresh liquid milk, butter, cheese, ice cream, and other dairy-based products from raw milk.
includes: manufacture of fresh liquid milk, pasteurized, sterilized, homogenized or ultra-heat treated
manufacture of cream from fresh liquid milk
manufacture of dried or condensed milk
manufacture of ice cream and other edible ice
excludes: retail sale of dairy products, see 4711
